Here at Juzo, we develop and manufacture next generation compression garments, supports and orthoses
using state-of-the-art technology for vein treatment, oedema therapy, scar therapy and orthopaedics.

Discover products that make your daily life easier – from medical compression stockings and scar

# Products for more freedom in motion

Here at Juzo, we develop and manufacture next generation compression garments, supports and orthoses
using state-of-the-art technology for vein treatment, oedema therapy, scar therapy and orthopaedics.

Discover products that make your daily life easier – from medical compression stockings and scar
care products to bandages and orthoses. At Juzo, you’ll find solutions that combine comfort, quality

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

## Step into color

Transform your compression stockings into a fashion and lifestyle statement with the new TREND
COLORS: effective compression therapy is combined with a trendy color selection that allows you to
emphasize your individuality.

[Discover TREND COLORS][10]

## Feel the natural effect

Discover our compression solutions with natural fibers for optimal comfort and not only benefit from
a light feeling in your legs thanks to compression, but also from the numerous benefits associated
with the use of natural cotton fibers.

[Read more][11]

### Color every moment

## Sigvaris flat knit in 5 vibrant colors

Explore our latest flat knitted compression garments in five unique colors across OPTIFORM HOLD,
FLEX, FEEL, and TOE CAPS.

[Discover now][12]

## Do the vein check now

Give your legs the attention they deserve and ensure a pain-free future on healthy legs.

[To the check][13]

## Medical compression solutions for you

Sigvaris compression solutions help you to go easily through your day. To feel strong and secure.
They give you the comfort to do everything you want, and they cater to your way of life.

[Read more][14]

## Compression stockings for all circumstances

Segment Essential

### Essential compression stockings - The all-round talents

Compression solutions from the Essential segment are designed for life situations where compression
stocking wearers, whether women or men, are looking for something uncomplicated. In this regard,
comfort and reliability are the top priorities. Essential stockings are the flexible everyday
companions, uncomplicated and yet visually appealing.
[Read more][15]
Segment Style

### Style compression stockings

Compression solutions from the Style segment are perfect for everyone for whom fashion aspects are
particularly important. They are always the right choice for those wish to make a fashionable,
self-confident appearance. No matter whether it's for leisure, special occasions or everyday work.
[Read more][16]
Segment Active

### Active compression stockings - For an active life

Compression stockings from the Active segment are suitable for people who are dependent on special
support in their dynamic lives. They are the ideal solution for all those who travel extensively,
like to move around a lot and are therefore looking for a stocking that always guarantees optimum
support. The special product properties of Active provide this security.
[Read more][17]


### How to avoid “economy class syndrome” while traveling

Anyone who travels long distances in a sitting position is at risk for leg complications. Wearing
compression socks or stockings can help prevent these problems and will greatly increase your
comfort along the way.
[Read more][18]

### Heavy legs

Are you asking yourself why your legs often feel heavy and uncomfortable? Discomfort of the legs,
like leg pain, heaviness, and/or leg tiredness, as well as swollen feet and ankles, can be first
signs of venous disorder. Medical compression can help.
[Read more][19]

### Style compression stockings

Compression solutions from the Style segment are perfect for everyone for whom fashion aspects are
particularly important. They are always the right choice for those wish to make a fashionable,
self-confident appearance. No matter whether it's for leisure, special occasions or everyday work.
[Read more][16]
Segment Active

### Active compression stockings - For an active life

Compression stockings from the Active segment are suitable for people who are dependent on special
support in their dynamic lives. They are the ideal solution for all those who travel extensively,
like to move around a lot and are therefore looking for a stocking that always guarantees optimum
support. The special product properties of Active provide this security.
[Read more][17]


### How to avoid “economy class syndrome” while traveling

Anyone who travels long distances in a sitting position is at risk for leg complications. Wearing
compression socks or stockings can help prevent these problems and will greatly increase your
comfort along the way.
[Read more][18]

### Heavy legs

Are you asking yourself why your legs often feel heavy and uncomfortable? Discomfort of the legs,
like leg pain, heaviness, and/or leg tiredness, as well as swollen feet and ankles, can be first
signs of venous disorder. Medical compression can help.
[Read more][19]

# Finding the best compression garment for you, wherever you are

[ ][45]
[ Previous ][46] [ Next ][47]

## Your dedicated partner in lymphedema management

Absolute Medical, Inc. exists to provide support and guidance throughout the lymphedema management
process. We are experts at fitting compression garments, working with insurance companies, and
educating you on the best product for your needs.

### Our advocates come to you

We’ll meet patients for garment fittings in our Chicago office, at their lymphedema therapy
appointment, or wherever is most convenient.

[Learn More][50]

> “Great customer service greeting, took the time to go over the garments on display. They explained
> in depth when everything would come in and how to maintain the garments. I would recommend
> everyone to come here!! I am a Home Healthcare worker so I know great service when I see it.”
> 
> – Victoria C., Chicago, IL

### We work with most major health insurance

We’ll talk directly to insurance providers so that patients can feel confident knowing their
available benefits. We work with multiple top-quality insurance companies so let us know your
insurance information and we can check if your insurance is covered.

[Verify insurance][51]

### Our products

We feature the latest in circular & flat knit compression garments, pumps, and bandages for treating
all stages of lymphedema.

[See products][52]

## We’re here to help.

Have questions? Reach out to us for answers.

## Your dedicated partner in lymphedema management

Absolute Medical, Inc. exists to provide support and guidance throughout the lymphedema management
process. We are experts at fitting compression garments, working with insurance companies, and
educating you on the best product for your needs.

### Our advocates come to you

We’ll meet patients for garment fittings in our Chicago office, at their lymphedema therapy
appointment, or wherever is most convenient.

[Learn More][50]

> “Great customer service greeting, took the time to go over the garments on display. They explained
> in depth when everything would come in and how to maintain the garments. I would recommend
> everyone to come here!! I am a Home Healthcare worker so I know great service when I see it.”
> 
> – Victoria C., Chicago, IL

### We work with most major health insurance

We’ll talk directly to insurance providers so that patients can feel confident knowing their
available benefits. We work with multiple top-quality insurance companies so let us know your
insurance information and we can check if your insurance is covered.

[Verify insurance][51]

### Our products

We feature the latest in circular & flat knit compression garments, pumps, and bandages for treating
all stages of lymphedema.

[See products][52]

Have questions? Reach out to us for answers.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## Answers for International Patients

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## Proudly serving Ontario since 2014
## from Mississauga

[Medical Equipment Specialists]

**Medical Equipment Specialists**

Our Medical Equipment Specialists are experts when it comes to selecting medical equipment. Their
goal is to understand your needs and provide you with solutions tailored to your challenge to help
live more independently and comfortably. Each of ADAPT Home Health Care’s Medical Equipment
Specialists are specialized in a specific product category whether it’s Lymphedema, Compression,
Bracing or Mobility! With locations in Mississauga and in Brampton, book an appointment with one of
our Medical Equipment Specialists!

[Funding Options Available]

****Funding Options Available****

There are also numerous government programs available that people are often unaware of.  ADAPT Home
Health Care is a government approved vendor for different types of medical equipment including
mobility and lymphedema.  We are also an approved WSIB vendor and work closely with the March of
Dimes and the ODSP Program.  Most private insurance plans also provide third party coverage for all
of these product categories.  Our Medical Equipment Specialists will work with you to determine what
funding options might be available.  We will help you facilitate through the paperwork and
documentation to ensure you receive this funding in a timely manner.

[White Glove Delivery & Installation Service ]

****White Glove Delivery & Installation Service ****

We provide delivery and installation services for all of our products. Our Service Technicians White
promise to deliver with a smile. Our goal is to provide you with the best service until the very
end! The white glove delivery and installation services are especially beneficial for larger pieces
of equipment such as lift chairs, hospital beds and hoyer lifts. Our service technicians are
professional and respectful of your home. They come well equipped with the tools they need to
deliver and set-up your medical equipment in your home and teach you how to use it. Our process
starts and ends with a smile and we want you to be smiling with us!

## Proudly serving Ontario since 2014
## from Mississauga

[Medical Equipment Specialists]

**Medical Equipment Specialists**

Our Medical Equipment Specialists are experts when it comes to selecting medical equipment. Their
goal is to understand your needs and provide you with solutions tailored to your challenge to help
live more independently and comfortably. Each of ADAPT Home Health Care’s Medical Equipment
Specialists are specialized in a specific product category whether it’s Lymphedema, Compression,
Bracing or Mobility! With locations in Mississauga and in Brampton, book an appointment with one of
our Medical Equipment Specialists!

[Funding Options Available]

****Funding Options Available****

There are also numerous government programs available that people are often unaware of.  ADAPT Home
Health Care is a government approved vendor for different types of medical equipment including
mobility and lymphedema.  We are also an approved WSIB vendor and work closely with the March of
Dimes and the ODSP Program.  Most private insurance plans also provide third party coverage for all
of these product categories.  Our Medical Equipment Specialists will work with you to determine what
funding options might be available.  We will help you facilitate through the paperwork and
documentation to ensure you receive this funding in a timely manner.

[White Glove Delivery & Installation Service ]

****White Glove Delivery & Installation Service ****

We provide delivery and installation services for all of our products. Our Service Technicians White
promise to deliver with a smile. Our goal is to provide you with the best service until the very
end! The white glove delivery and installation services are especially beneficial for larger pieces
of equipment such as lift chairs, hospital beds and hoyer lifts. Our service technicians are
professional and respectful of your home. They come well equipped with the tools they need to
deliver and set-up your medical equipment in your home and teach you how to use it. Our process
starts and ends with a smile and we want you to be smiling with us!

## Customer stories

[Debsza Kormos]

**Debsza Kormos**

**My journey with Truscott started in Oct 2016 when I purchased my rollator with them through the
Ontario ADP Program.  The HHC staff are courteous, very helpful, understanding & accommodating, with
repairs, maintenance, and recommendations.  Truscott rocks 🙂**

[CS]

**CS**

**The kindest staff. The head pharmacist Moos (spelling may be off) is so understanding and cares
about the people they serve. Never make me feel guilty for forgetting a refill, will always do what
they can do help. Any medication questions I have I know I can trust their advice. Truly thankful
for this pharmacy. They've made the medication part of chronic illness easier which makes a huge
difference when you live with it. All other staff are friendly and helpful as well. My family and I
have been going there for years and hope to never have to change.**

[Karla Cinapri]

**Karla Cinapri**

**We need more places like Truscott I.D.A.  The front staff at the pharmacy greeted us with a smile
the minute we walked through the door and directed  to where we needed to go. Thank you to the
attentive and knowledgeable staff at Adapt Home Health Care.  ADAPT helped to coordinate a home
visit with a licensed OT (Occupational Therapist) for my elderly grandmother and quickly filled the
order for her equipment.  This level of customer service is hard to find.**

[Ghada Elsaadany]

**Ghada Elsaadany**

**Excellent support, very valuable information and efficient understanding to the patients needed
products**

[Joyce Macaalay]

**Joyce Macaalay**

**They have comfortable compression socks with a variety of designs and colors. Flu shot is also
available here. They always assist customers. This pharmacy is highly recommended for the best
customer service!!!**

[Judy Campbell]

**Judy Campbell**

**I am very pleased with the service I have received.  I have been talking with Maria Wood, she has
been very helpful and informative.  I just watched a video, it is very good, and also helpful.  I
appreciate the good care.**

[Elizabeth Desouza]

**Elizabeth Desouza**

I have been a patient of Maria with ADAPT for over 5 years. I’ve been having problems with my
lymphedema and have been fitted with special garments for my hands and a gauntlet for my fingers and
I’ve been so satisfied. Maria has been really fantastic and has helped me with all of my ailments
and all of my needs. I couldn’t have asked for anything better. Thank you!

[Susmita Mithia]

**Susmita Mithia**

**I am a patient at ADAPT Home Health Care.  I use compression stockings because of the swelling in
my feet and a lot of swelling and blood circulation issues.  I have used compression stockings for
more than 4 years and I always come to ADAPT Health Care to purchase my compression stockings.   The
staff here are always very nice and very forthcoming.  Compression stockings are the best for
varicose veins and if you are feet are hurting.  Everyone should be wearing them!**

## Meet Ami Hollis, CLT, BSN

## Certified Lymphedema Therapist | U.S. Air Force Veteran | Holistic Nurse Educator
##  
## As proud Lake Havasu City resident since 1973, I’ve dedicated my life to serving others—first in
## the United States Air Force during Operation Desert Storm, and later as a Registered Nurse right
## here in my hometown. My path has taken me through long-term care, hospice, public health, and
## private practice, but today, I’m proud to focus on lymphatic therapy as a Certified Lymphedema
## Therapist (CLT), helping my clients heal, recover, and thrive.
##  
## I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Northern Arizona University in 1998, where I was
## introduced to holistic nursing through a mentor who served as President of the Holistic Nursing
## Association. That experience shaped my core belief: healthcare is a partnership, and education is
## its most powerful tool. I believe that when clients are empowered with knowledge and given
## choices, they’re more likely to engage in their healing process—and that’s where real
## transformation begins.

[lymphatic_therapist_mohave_county.jpg]

### Military Service & a Personal Mission

During my Air Force service from 1988–1994, I had the honor of working alongside remarkable people,
including a fellow veteran whose battle with laryngeal cancer would change the trajectory of my
career. He introduced me to Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) and Complete Decongestive Therapy (CDT), and
I saw firsthand how dramatically it improved his speech, swelling, and quality of life. His
therapist became his lifeline—and inspired me to become one, too.

 

That experience led me to pursue full Certified Lymphedema Therapist credentials through the Academy
of Lymphatic Studies. I’m continuing my advanced training and will earn my certification in Advanced
Lymphatic Management by December 2025.

### Passionate About Healing

My mission is to bring the power of lymphatic therapy to anyone who needs or wants it—from cancer
patients and surgical clients to athletes, migraine sufferers, and those managing chronic fatigue or
inflammation.

 

I offer gentle, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to:
* Cancer-related swelling & radiation recovery
* Post-surgical healing (cosmetic & orthopedic)
* Plastic surgery recovery (pre/post-op)
* Autoimmune-related swelling and chronic inflammation
* Headache & migraine relief
* Trauma & injury rehabilitation
* General wellness and immune support


As an Authorized Juzo® Retailer, I also provide:
* Custom compression garments
* Mastectomy bras and prosthetics
* Insurance billing for most major plans

### Serving My Community with Heart

From my earliest days volunteering at Smoketree Elementary to my involvement in Girl Scouts, 4-H,
NHS, and beyond, I’ve always believed in giving back to the community that raised me. Whether I’m
working one-on-one in my clinic, educating clients, or helping someone find the right garment for
their needs, my purpose is the same: to help people live with less pain, less swelling, and more
confidence.

 

Healing isn’t just about treatment—it’s about teamwork. And the most important member of that team
is you.

## Meet Ami Hollis, CLT, BSN

## Certified Lymphedema Therapist | U.S. Air Force Veteran | Holistic Nurse Educator
##  
## As proud Lake Havasu City resident since 1973, I’ve dedicated my life to serving others—first in
## the United States Air Force during Operation Desert Storm, and later as a Registered Nurse right
## here in my hometown. My path has taken me through long-term care, hospice, public health, and
## private practice, but today, I’m proud to focus on lymphatic therapy as a Certified Lymphedema
## Therapist (CLT), helping my clients heal, recover, and thrive.
##  
## I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Northern Arizona University in 1998, where I was
## introduced to holistic nursing through a mentor who served as President of the Holistic Nursing
## Association. That experience shaped my core belief: healthcare is a partnership, and education is
## its most powerful tool. I believe that when clients are empowered with knowledge and given
## choices, they’re more likely to engage in their healing process—and that’s where real
## transformation begins.

[lymphatic_therapist_mohave_county.jpg]

### Military Service & a Personal Mission

During my Air Force service from 1988–1994, I had the honor of working alongside remarkable people,
including a fellow veteran whose battle with laryngeal cancer would change the trajectory of my
career. He introduced me to Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) and Complete Decongestive Therapy (CDT), and
I saw firsthand how dramatically it improved his speech, swelling, and quality of life. His
therapist became his lifeline—and inspired me to become one, too.

 

That experience led me to pursue full Certified Lymphedema Therapist credentials through the Academy
of Lymphatic Studies. I’m continuing my advanced training and will earn my certification in Advanced
Lymphatic Management by December 2025.

### Passionate About Healing

My mission is to bring the power of lymphatic therapy to anyone who needs or wants it—from cancer
patients and surgical clients to athletes, migraine sufferers, and those managing chronic fatigue or
inflammation.

 

I offer gentle, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to:
* Cancer-related swelling & radiation recovery
* Post-surgical healing (cosmetic & orthopedic)
* Plastic surgery recovery (pre/post-op)
* Autoimmune-related swelling and chronic inflammation
* Headache & migraine relief
* Trauma & injury rehabilitation
* General wellness and immune support


As an Authorized Juzo® Retailer, I also provide:
* Custom compression garments
* Mastectomy bras and prosthetics
* Insurance billing for most major plans

### Serving My Community with Heart

From my earliest days volunteering at Smoketree Elementary to my involvement in Girl Scouts, 4-H,
NHS, and beyond, I’ve always believed in giving back to the community that raised me. Whether I’m
working one-on-one in my clinic, educating clients, or helping someone find the right garment for
their needs, my purpose is the same: to help people live with less pain, less swelling, and more
confidence.

 

Healing isn’t just about treatment—it’s about teamwork. And the most important member of that team
is you.

[Abstract Beige Texture]

> "Gentle touch, profound healing"

A Light Touch & Holistic Healing

# WELCOME

Welcome, New Clients

A Free 30 min. Consultation by phone or in person is highly recommended prior to booking a full
appointment online. This enables us to tailor your first session to your current health & wellness
needs

## Our Treatments

[Lymphatic_Massage_Therpist_Mohave_County.png]
[Service02.jpg]
[JUZO btnMultiColor logo_edited.png]

### Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) Massage

Discover the benefits of Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) massage in a personalized one-on-one session.
Experience the gentle, rhythmic movements that support lymph flow and enhance your body's natural
detoxification processes. Great for overall wellness, relief from anxiety, migraines, fibromyalgia,
arthritis, or any chronic inflammation.

Book Now

### Complete Lymphatic Decongestive Therapy

Experience gentle yet effective Complete Lymphatic Decongestive Therapy, utilizing the Vodder (MLD)
massage technique for pre & post op care, plastic surgery, during & after cancer
surgery/chemo/radiation treatments, lymphedema/lipedema care & specialized bandage wrapping with
wound/skin care.

[Book Now][7]

### Authorized Juzo®
### Compression Garment Retailer

A Light Touch Holistic Healing is proud to be an Authorized Retailer for Juzo®, a global leader in
medical compression therapy since 1912. Juzo's high-quality compression garments are designed to
improve circulation, reduce swelling, and support overall wellness. Their products are latex-free,
breathable, and available in a variety of styles and compression levels to meet individual needs. As
a Certified Lymphedema Therapist (CLT), Ami Hollis offers personalized fittings and guidance to help
clients select the appropriate Juzo® products for conditions such as lymphedema, venous
insufficiency, and post-surgical recovery. Explore our range of Juzo® products: Compression
Stockings & Socks: Ideal for managing tired legs, varicose veins, and chronic swelling. Arm Sleeves
& Gauntlets: Designed for upper extremity lymphedema management. Compression Wraps: Adjustable
solutions for various compression needs. Custom-Fit Garments: Tailored options for unique body
shapes and specific medical requirements.

[Discover all our treatments][8]

## A Light Touch & Holistic Healing are proudly
## featured on MyRadioCentral

Did you know A Light Touch Holistic Healing is now on the airwaves with [MyRadioCentral][9]? Lake
Havasu City's trusted source for local news, talk, and entertainment. As a 100% locally owned and
operated network, [MyRadioCentral][10] connects our community through stations like:

* Nash KJJJ Country 102.3 FM
* KNTR News Talk Radio 106.3 FM
* KNTR Sports 980 AM / 94.3 FM / 100.5 FM


Tune in to hear our latest radio spot and discover how our certified lymphatic therapy services can
support your wellness journey.

[radiocentral1117.jpg]
00:00 / 00:30

"As someone who's been fighting the hard fight against laryngeal cancer, I can't say enough about my
experience with lymphatic drainage therapy—it has truly been a Godsend.

I was fortunate to begin lymphatic drainage treatments alongside my radiation therapy, and I firmly
believe it's the one thing that has made the biggest difference in my recovery. The swelling in my
neck—something that could have made everything harder—was kept under control. Most importantly, this
therapy helped me keep my voice, even after undergoing a tracheostomy.

There are days I go into my appointment barely able to speak. But after each session, I come out and
people can hear me clearly again. It’s nothing short of incredible.

This is the one appointment I never miss. It’s not just a treatment—it’s a lifeline. I will never
stop being grateful to my Certified Lymphatic Therapist.

> There are no words strong enough to express my gratitude."

Mick Dunn, USN Veteran

## Commonly Asked Questions

#### [ Q1. Can we order socks made according to our custom logo?][73]

YES. If you have your logo or design ready, you can use it. We also have our designers at your
disposal if you have only an idea in mind. Working with you, the designers can take your ideas and
turn them into great socks designs customized for your needs.

#### [Q2. Can you offer me a free stock sample?][74]

YES. We are glad to send you a sample of our sock products. However, if you want custom samples, you
have to contact us for a special arrangement for custom samples.

#### [Q3.What range of sock items do you have for sale?][75]

We have all sorts of socks for sale. These are sports socks, compression socks, baby socks, children
socks, diabetes socks, thermal socks, work socks, crew socks, and so on. You can contact us for all
your range of socks needs.

#### [Q4. What materials do you use to manufacture your socks?][76]

We use a range of materials such as Cotton, BCI cotton, spandex, nylon, polyester, bamboo, Coolmax,
acrylic, combed cotton, mercerized cotton, wool, etc. You can always contact us for more materials

## Comprexx Fabric Advantage

# The fabric used in compression garments is carefully engineered to provide therapeutic benefits
# while ensuring compliance comfort, durability, and effectiveness. 

### Two Way Dimensional Stretch

Two-way dimensional stretch refers to the fabric's ability to stretch both horizontally and
vertically. This characteristic is essential for compression garments, as it allows the fabric to
move and conform to the body’s shape, providing a snug and supportive fit.

### Breathability

Compression garment fabrics are typically made from breathable materials that allow air circulation,
helping to regulate body temperature and prevent excessive sweating. This ensures comfort during
extended wear.

### Moisture-Wicking

The fabric is often moisture-wicking, which means it effectively draws sweat away from the skin to
the outer surface of the garment, where it can evaporate. This keeps the skin dry and reduces the
risk of skin irritation or infection.

### Softness and Comfort

Despite its strength, the fabric is soft to the touch, reducing the likelihood of chafing or
discomfort. The material is carefully chosen to ensure comfort, especially for those who need to
wear the garments for extended periods.

### Lightweight Design

Compression garments are often made from lightweight materials, ensuring that they do not add bulk
and can be worn discreetly under clothing.

### Hypoallergenic

The fabrics used are usually hypoallergenic, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions or skin
sensitivities, which is crucial for individuals with delicate or reactive skin.

### Easy Maintenance

These fabrics are typically easy to care for, being washable and quick-drying, making them
convenient for everyday use.

## Comprexx Fabric Advantage

# The fabric used in compression garments is carefully engineered to provide therapeutic benefits

### Two Way Dimensional Stretch

Two-way dimensional stretch refers to the fabric's ability to stretch both horizontally and
vertically. This characteristic is essential for compression garments, as it allows the fabric to
move and conform to the body’s shape, providing a snug and supportive fit.

### Breathability

Compression garment fabrics are typically made from breathable materials that allow air circulation,
helping to regulate body temperature and prevent excessive sweating. This ensures comfort during
extended wear.

### Moisture-Wicking

The fabric is often moisture-wicking, which means it effectively draws sweat away from the skin to
the outer surface of the garment, where it can evaporate. This keeps the skin dry and reduces the
risk of skin irritation or infection.

### Softness and Comfort

Despite its strength, the fabric is soft to the touch, reducing the likelihood of chafing or
discomfort. The material is carefully chosen to ensure comfort, especially for those who need to
wear the garments for extended periods.

### Lightweight Design

Compression garments are often made from lightweight materials, ensuring that they do not add bulk
and can be worn discreetly under clothing.

### Hypoallergenic

The fabrics used are usually hypoallergenic, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions or skin
sensitivities, which is crucial for individuals with delicate or reactive skin.

### Easy Maintenance

These fabrics are typically easy to care for, being washable and quick-drying, making them
convenient for everyday use.

## What are Compression Garments?

***Compression garments are post-op, therapeutic aids engineered to help you recover with comfort,
speed and confidence.***

No matter your body type, gender, surgical procedure, recovery timeline or lifestyle, compression
garments can help! Take a look at any of our great guides to learn more about how compression
garments can benefit you!

We have more than 35 years of experience in the manufacturing of medical grade compression garments
for post-surgical recovery process and for daily benefit. We are proud to offer high-quality
compression garments with insightful features to achieve optimal results in less time during the
recovery process, while also reducing unwanted side effects and risks.

Our compression garments are made to order to fit every defined curve and subtle contour of the body
– giving patients complete comfort and relaxation after surgery, or in their daily lives.

## Deep Plane Facelift Surgery in Sydney

Dr Scott Turner is a Specialist Plastic Surgeon in Sydney with a focus on facial aesthetic surgery,
including [deep plane facelift][160], neck lift, eyelid surgery and [facial fat transfer][161]. A
deep plane facelift is a structural facelift technique that works beneath the SMAS layer to release
retaining ligaments and reposition descended facial tissues as a composite unit.

This approach may be considered for suitable patients with midface descent, jowling, jawline laxity
and neck ageing. Dr Turner consults from Bondi Junction and Manly, with [facelift surgery][162]
performed in accredited Sydney private hospitals. Patients considering facial rejuvenation can learn
more about the procedure, recovery, risks, costs and suitability criteria on the dedicated deep
plane facelift page.

rhinoplasty, eyelid surgery, and breast and body procedures.

He practises from [Sydney clinics][182] in [Bondi Junction][183] and [Manly][184], and also consults
in [Brisbane][185] and [Canberra][186]. Surgery is performed at Bondi Junction Private Hospital and
Delmar Private Hospital, Dee Why.

Dr Turner’s areas of particular focus include [deep plane facelift][187] and broader [facelift
surgery][188], [cosmetic rhinoplasty][189] and [functional rhinoplasty][190], [upper
blepharoplasty][191] and [lower blepharoplasty][192], [brow lift][193], and [neck lift][194]
procedures. He approaches each consultation with the same framework — a thorough assessment of the
individual’s anatomy, an honest conversation about what surgery may and may not achieve, and a
surgical plan that fits the patient rather than a template.

## Travel & Everyday Wellbeing

Wearing medical compression garments is essential for a more comfortable and safer trip, especially
during long periods of sitting. Here are the key reasons to wear them when you travel:
* **Enhance All-Day Comfort:** Compression wear is designed to provide continuous support and
  comfort throughout your journey.
* **Reduce Serious Health Risks:** Specialized travel socks reduce the chance of developing travel
  thrombosis (blood clots), which can be caused by prolonged sitting in cars, trains, or planes.
* **Prevent Swelling and Discomfort:** The garments work to prevent mild to moderate symptoms, such

## Travel & Everyday Wellbeing

Wearing medical compression garments is essential for a more comfortable and safer trip, especially
during long periods of sitting. Here are the key reasons to wear them when you travel:
* **Enhance All-Day Comfort:** Compression wear is designed to provide continuous support and
  comfort throughout your journey.
* **Reduce Serious Health Risks:** Specialized travel socks reduce the chance of developing travel
  thrombosis (blood clots), which can be caused by prolonged sitting in cars, trains, or planes.
* **Prevent Swelling and Discomfort:** The garments work to prevent mild to moderate symptoms, such
  as swelling and aches, that commonly occur during travel.

# who we are

[hope 4 healing]







Hope 4 Healing is a supplier of quality compression garments, wound care bandages/supplies and
mastectomy products.  We offer low prices and quality products to help you on your road to healing.



Patients with Lymphedema, Venous Insufficiency, and other vein diseases require bandaging supplies
and/or compression garments.  The bandaging supplies and garments, if used properly, keep swelling
under control and allow the patients to live a much more normal life. We offer top quality brands
for your lymphedema garments and/or medical compression garments and the most up to date products
available on the market.



Breast prosthesis (forms) and mastectomy bras are available.



Please contact us  for an appointment with one of our custom fitters. We will measure you for off
the shelf garments or custom garments, whichever you require.



You, our customer, are our top priority.  Our caring, experienced, compassionate staff will offer to
you, hope for healing.

## about us

#### Vision

 Hope 4 Healing will be the premier Lymphedema and Mastectomy medical supply company in southeastern
Pennsylvania and Florida.  We will grow exponentially because of the twenty plus years of combined
experience our staff has in this field.  Our envisioned future is to be the source all therapists
call to manage the complications of Lymphedema and Mastectomy’s.  Our compassion and knowledge will
give our patients hope for healing. 

#### Mission

  Hope 4 Healing’s mission is to provide Lymphedema compression garments in a timely and cost
effective manner with the highest level of service possible.  We are committed to meeting the needs
of our patients through our knowledge, experience and professionalism. Hope 4 Healing recognizes
that patient needs come first and responding to their needs is paramount to the healing process.  At
Hope 4 Healing you will receive excellent care from our professional custom fitters through our
efficient order processing to assuring your utmost comfort in your new compression garments. 

#### Values

Hope 4 Healing’s core values are the treatment of patients first and foremost. We treat all patients
with the same amount of respect and compassion. We prove to our customers that we care by pricing as
low as the market will allow us to, ensuring that all patients can receive the life-changing
garments that they need in their road toward healing. We value our customers and they will value our
integrity and responsible business practices.

# Medigarments Ltd

## is a company that has built its reputation by producing outstanding quality medical products for
## over 40 years

Medigarments Ltd, is the company behind the inter­nati­onally recognised brands Jobskin^{®} and
SDO^{®}. We lead the way in rehabi­lita­tion therapy and are the largest UK manufacturer of specialist
bespoke compression garments supplied through therapy and orthotic profes­si­onals.

Our reputation for the design, and supply of technically advanced garments has been built over more
than 40 years supplying the highest quality made-to-measure products.

From our roots producing traditional corsetry in the 1950’s to complex structural medical garments
today, we are proud to say that 100% of our garments are still made in the UK.

Our products are used in the management of scarring as a result of burns or trauma injury, and in
the field of dynamic compression, where they are used to increase sensory and propri­ocep­tive
feedback as well as to provide muscu­los­ke­letal support. We are also one of only a handful of
companies still producing made-to-measure boned corsets.

# Liposuction NYC: Redefine Your Shape and Reclaim Your Confidence

You’ve seen that familiar reflection in the mirror—one that doesn’t quite match the vision you hold
inside. It’s not that you haven’t tried every new boutique fitness class, every mindful eating
program, or every trick in the health magazines. It’s that some stubborn pockets of fat simply
refuse to budge. If this story resonates with you, you’re not alone—and more importantly, you’re not
without options. At the **Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic**, we understand that the way you feel
about your body’s shape can influence every aspect of your life. Our mission is to help you close
the gap between who you are now and who you want to become.

The truth is, **liposuction** isn’t just about removing fat—it’s about revealing a more confident
version of yourself. It’s about finally slipping into that tailored suit or fitted dress and feeling
like you belong in it. It’s about turning heads for the right reasons—not because you’re hiding, but
because you’re standing taller, prouder, and freer than ever before.

In its essence, **liposuction** is a surgical procedure that targets and removes excess fat cells to
sculpt your body’s natural contours. Commonly performed on the abdomen, thighs, arms, and back,
liposuction reduces unwanted bulges that remain, despite your best efforts with diet and exercise.
According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, liposuction consistently ranks among the top
cosmetic procedures in the United States, with thousands choosing it each year for effective,
lasting results.

fine-tuning a musical instrument—you’re not composing a brand-new melody; you’re perfecting the one
that already exists inside you. That’s why candidates ideally maintain a stable weight and commit to
a healthy lifestyle both before and after the procedure. In short, liposuction sets the stage for
the real transformation: how you choose to celebrate and maintain your new form.

carefully orchestrated experience designed to deliver life-changing results. We bring together a
multidisciplinary team of board-certified cosmetic surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, and patient

just remove fat; they sculpt harmonious proportions that respect your body’s natural curves. Using
the latest techniques—like **tumescent liposuction** or **laser-assisted liposuction
(SmartLipo)**—we minimize trauma to the tissues, reduce downtime, and optimize results. Our facility
is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and follows rigorous safety protocols, ensuring you
receive top-tier care in the heart of New York City.

## Customizing Your Procedure: The Consultation Process

The journey begins with a conversation. During your initial consultation, you’ll meet with a
seasoned surgeon who will guide you through the possibilities. We’ll ask about your goals, your
history, and the dreams you hold for your future self. Maybe you’ve been eyeing a sleeker silhouette
for your wedding day or seeking more proportionate contours after achieving significant weight loss.
Whatever your reason, we listen closely, because personalized care isn’t just a catchphrase—it’s the
foundation of everything we do.

### What can you expect during your consultation?
* **In-Depth Discussion:** We explore your expectations, motivations, and lifestyle habits to ensure
  a holistic understanding of your situation.
* **Physical Examination:** Your surgeon will evaluate target areas, skin elasticity, and overall
  health to determine the best approach.
* **Customized Treatment Plan:** Based on this information, we’ll recommend the technique that suits
  you best, from traditional suction-assisted liposuction to advanced laser-assisted methods. We’ll
  also discuss anesthesia options, recovery timelines, and cost transparency so you can make an
  informed decision

By the end of the consultation, you’ll have a personalized roadmap—a plan that aligns your unique
anatomy with your most desired outcome.

## From Preparation to Recovery: The Complete Liposuction Journey

### Pre-Procedure Steps

#### Setting the Stage for Success:

Before your procedure day arrives, we’ll help you prepare both mentally and physically. We may
advise you to stop certain medications, quit smoking if applicable, and arrange for a supportive
environment at home. The goal is to ensure you’re in the best possible condition, as a healthy body
recovers more quickly and achieves superior results.

### The Day of Surgery

On the morning of your appointment, you’ll step into our welcoming, discreet clinic feeling more
like a guest than a patient. Our team will greet you warmly, review your treatment plan, and make
sure you’re comfortable. After administering local or general anesthesia—depending on your
customized approach—your surgeon will begin the procedure.

With careful, deliberate movements, they’ll remove targeted fat cells through small, strategically
placed incisions. Precision is key. Every action is designed to refine, not merely extract. By the
time we’re finished, we aim to deliver not just less fat, but more symmetry, balance, and proportion
in your body.

### Recovery and Beyond

#### The First Few Days:

Expect some swelling, bruising, and mild discomfort—normal signals that your body is healing. You’ll
likely wear a compression garment to reduce swelling and help your skin adapt to its new contours.
Follow-up visits with our clinic will ensure that everything is progressing smoothly, and we’ll
provide detailed instructions on caring for your incisions, maintaining hygiene, and resuming light
activities.

#### Long-Term Results:

Within a few weeks, you’ll start noticing the difference, and over a few months, your new shape will
settle into place. Remember: Liposuction permanently removes fat cells from the treated areas. With
a balanced diet, regular exercise, and a commitment to self-care, you can enjoy your results for
years to come.

## Is Liposuction Right for You? Candidacy & Considerations

Liposuction isn’t a one-size-fits-all solution. It’s ideal for individuals who are close to their
target weight, have good skin elasticity, and maintain realistic expectations. If you’re struggling
primarily with excess skin or severely weakened abdominal muscles, other procedures—like a **tummy
tuck**—may serve you better. We may also explore the possibility of combining liposuction with
complementary treatments, such as **breast augmentation** or **Brazilian butt lift**, to achieve a
more comprehensive transformation.

#### Red Flags & When to Reconsider:
* If you’re seeking liposuction for drastic weight loss, you may be disappointed.
* If you’re not ready to maintain healthy habits post-surgery, results may diminish over time.
* If you have significant medical issues or unstable weight, we might recommend waiting until your
  condition stabilizes.

Our team will always offer honest guidance. At the end of the day, the best candidates for
liposuction approach it as an investment in their confidence—not a shortcut to an unattainable
ideal.

## Alternatives to Liposuction: Non-Invasive Options to Consider

Sometimes, the answer isn’t surgical. Maybe you’re not comfortable with going under anesthesia.
Maybe you have just a small area of concern that could benefit from a non-invasive solution. We get
it. That’s why our clinic also provides **non-surgical body contouring** treatments, like
**CoolSculpting** or **SculpSure**.

These alternatives use methods like targeted cooling or laser energy to break down fat cells without
incisions. They offer less downtime and fewer side effects, though they also deliver subtler results
over a longer timeline. For many individuals, these treatments serve as stepping stones or
maintenance tools, helping them refine their shape in a gentler, more gradual way.

## Ensuring Lasting Results: Post-Procedure Lifestyle & Maintenance

As proud as we are of the transformations we facilitate, we know that true change happens when you
integrate these results into your life. Liposuction isn’t a finish line; it’s an invitation to
nurture a more vibrant, healthful lifestyle. Think of it as a turning point—an opportunity to double
down on habits that celebrate your body rather than punish it.

#### Tips for Maintaining Results:
* **Healthy Eating:** Focus on nutrient-dense, whole foods. Consider working with a nutritionist to
  craft a sustainable eating plan.
* **Regular Exercise:** Incorporate strength training, cardio, and flexibility exercises to keep
  your body strong and energized.
* **Mind-Body Wellness:** Practices like yoga, meditation, or journaling can help you appreciate
  your new shape and maintain a positive mindset.
* **Consistent Follow-Ups:** Check in with our team periodically. We’re invested in your long-term
  success and can provide guidance whenever you need it.

It’s this synergy—surgical precision combined with long-term lifestyle improvements—that creates not
just a new look, but a new narrative for your life.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### How much fat can be removed during liposuction?

There are safe limits to how much fat can be extracted in a single session. Generally, removing up
to five liters of fat is considered safe. Your surgeon will advise you on realistic expectations
based on your anatomy and goals.

### Will I have visible scars?

Liposuction incisions are usually tiny, placed in discreet areas, and often fade over time. Proper
care, along with following post-operative instructions, can minimize their appearance. Additionally,
scar treatments like silicone gel sheets can further improve their look.

### How soon can I return to work or exercise?

Most patients resume light activities within a week or two, though this varies depending on the
complexity of your procedure and your personal healing rate. Strenuous exercise typically resumes
after four to six weeks, with your surgeon’s approval.

### Is liposuction permanent?

The fat cells removed do not return. However, if you gain weight, remaining fat cells can expand,

Before your procedure day arrives, we’ll help you prepare both mentally and physically. We may
advise you to stop certain medications, quit smoking if applicable, and arrange for a supportive
environment at home. The goal is to ensure you’re in the best possible condition, as a healthy body
recovers more quickly and achieves superior results.

### The Day of Surgery

On the morning of your appointment, you’ll step into our welcoming, discreet clinic feeling more
like a guest than a patient. Our team will greet you warmly, review your treatment plan, and make
sure you’re comfortable. After administering local or general anesthesia—depending on your
customized approach—your surgeon will begin the procedure.

With careful, deliberate movements, they’ll remove targeted fat cells through small, strategically
placed incisions. Precision is key. Every action is designed to refine, not merely extract. By the
time we’re finished, we aim to deliver not just less fat, but more symmetry, balance, and proportion
in your body.

### Recovery and Beyond

#### The First Few Days:

Expect some swelling, bruising, and mild discomfort—normal signals that your body is healing. You’ll
likely wear a compression garment to reduce swelling and help your skin adapt to its new contours.
Follow-up visits with our clinic will ensure that everything is progressing smoothly, and we’ll
provide detailed instructions on caring for your incisions, maintaining hygiene, and resuming light
activities.

#### Long-Term Results:

Within a few weeks, you’ll start noticing the difference, and over a few months, your new shape will
settle into place. Remember: Liposuction permanently removes fat cells from the treated areas. With
a balanced diet, regular exercise, and a commitment to self-care, you can enjoy your results for
years to come.

## Is Liposuction Right for You? Candidacy & Considerations

Liposuction isn’t a one-size-fits-all solution. It’s ideal for individuals who are close to their
target weight, have good skin elasticity, and maintain realistic expectations. If you’re struggling
primarily with excess skin or severely weakened abdominal muscles, other procedures—like a **tummy
tuck**—may serve you better. We may also explore the possibility of combining liposuction with
complementary treatments, such as **breast augmentation** or **Brazilian butt lift**, to achieve a
more comprehensive transformation.

#### Red Flags & When to Reconsider:
* If you’re seeking liposuction for drastic weight loss, you may be disappointed.
* If you’re not ready to maintain healthy habits post-surgery, results may diminish over time.
* If you have significant medical issues or unstable weight, we might recommend waiting until your
  condition stabilizes.

Our team will always offer honest guidance. At the end of the day, the best candidates for
liposuction approach it as an investment in their confidence—not a shortcut to an unattainable
ideal.

## Alternatives to Liposuction: Non-Invasive Options to Consider

Sometimes, the answer isn’t surgical. Maybe you’re not comfortable with going under anesthesia.
Maybe you have just a small area of concern that could benefit from a non-invasive solution. We get
it. That’s why our clinic also provides **non-surgical body contouring** treatments, like
**CoolSculpting** or **SculpSure**.

These alternatives use methods like targeted cooling or laser energy to break down fat cells without
incisions. They offer less downtime and fewer side effects, though they also deliver subtler results
over a longer timeline. For many individuals, these treatments serve as stepping stones or
maintenance tools, helping them refine their shape in a gentler, more gradual way.

## Ensuring Lasting Results: Post-Procedure Lifestyle & Maintenance

As proud as we are of the transformations we facilitate, we know that true change happens when you
integrate these results into your life. Liposuction isn’t a finish line; it’s an invitation to
nurture a more vibrant, healthful lifestyle. Think of it as a turning point—an opportunity to double
down on habits that celebrate your body rather than punish it.

#### Tips for Maintaining Results:
* **Healthy Eating:** Focus on nutrient-dense, whole foods. Consider working with a nutritionist to
  craft a sustainable eating plan.
* **Regular Exercise:** Incorporate strength training, cardio, and flexibility exercises to keep
  your body strong and energized.
* **Mind-Body Wellness:** Practices like yoga, meditation, or journaling can help you appreciate
  your new shape and maintain a positive mindset.
* **Consistent Follow-Ups:** Check in with our team periodically. We’re invested in your long-term
  success and can provide guidance whenever you need it.

It’s this synergy—surgical precision combined with long-term lifestyle improvements—that creates not
just a new look, but a new narrative for your life.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### How much fat can be removed during liposuction?

There are safe limits to how much fat can be extracted in a single session. Generally, removing up
to five liters of fat is considered safe. Your surgeon will advise you on realistic expectations
based on your anatomy and goals.

### Will I have visible scars?

Liposuction incisions are usually tiny, placed in discreet areas, and often fade over time. Proper
care, along with following post-operative instructions, can minimize their appearance. Additionally,
scar treatments like silicone gel sheets can further improve their look.

### How soon can I return to work or exercise?

Most patients resume light activities within a week or two, though this varies depending on the
complexity of your procedure and your personal healing rate. Strenuous exercise typically resumes
after four to six weeks, with your surgeon’s approval.

### Is liposuction permanent?

The fat cells removed do not return. However, if you gain weight, remaining fat cells can expand,
potentially altering your contours. Consistent maintenance—healthy diet, exercise, and overall

DiscountSurgical now accepts eligible Medicare insurance for compression garments on the LymphRx
website. Patients with lymphedema can use their Medicare Part B benefits when purchasing prescribed
compression products. This coverage includes compression sleeves, stockings, and related supplies
available through DiscountSurgical's LymphRx website

# What Medicare Now Covers

Medicare's new coverage includes:

✓ Compression stockings (various pressure levels) ✓ Compression sleeves for arms and legs ✓
Compression gloves and gauntlets ✓ Compression wraps and bandages

** ****Coverage Requirements:**
* You must have a qualifying medical condition diagnosed by a Medicare-enrolled physician
* Your doctor must prescribe the compression garments as medically necessary
* The garments must be supplied by a Medicare-approved provider
* Documentation must show that compression therapy is required for your specific condition

** **

**Coverage Requirements:**
* 3 compression garments per limb every 6 months

# Eligibility

To qualify for Medicare coverage under the Lymphedema Treatment Act, the following conditions must
be met:
* Lymphedema Diagnosis: A confirmed diagnosis of lymphedema, supported by appropriate medical
  documentation.
* Prescription for Compression Garments: A prescription from a qualified healthcare provider, such
  as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or clinical nurse specialist. This
  prescription must be for compression garments or bandaging supplies specifically intended to treat
  lymphedema symptoms.
* Medicare Part B Enrollment: The individual must be enrolled in Medicare Part B, which covers
  durable medical equipment (DME) and related supplies.

# The Process
* **Schedule an appointment** with your healthcare provider to discuss your need for compression
  therapy
* **Get a prescription **or use our RX template that includes:
  * Your Lymphedema diagnosis
  * The type of compression garment recommended
  * The compression level needed (measured in mmHg)
  * How many garments are needed
  * How often they should be replaced
* **Call  Lymphrx.com** - a Medicare-approved supplier — to review your order
* **Submit your prescription **and Medicare information to us
* **Receive your compression garments** and begin experiencing the benefits!

website. Patients with lymphedema can use their Medicare Part B benefits when purchasing prescribed
compression products. This coverage includes compression sleeves, stockings, and related supplies
available through DiscountSurgical's LymphRx website

# What Medicare Now Covers

Medicare's new coverage includes:

✓ Compression stockings (various pressure levels) ✓ Compression sleeves for arms and legs ✓
Compression gloves and gauntlets ✓ Compression wraps and bandages

** ****Coverage Requirements:**
* You must have a qualifying medical condition diagnosed by a Medicare-enrolled physician
* Your doctor must prescribe the compression garments as medically necessary
* The garments must be supplied by a Medicare-approved provider
* Documentation must show that compression therapy is required for your specific condition

** **

**Coverage Requirements:**
* 3 compression garments per limb every 6 months

# Eligibility

To qualify for Medicare coverage under the Lymphedema Treatment Act, the following conditions must
be met:
* Lymphedema Diagnosis: A confirmed diagnosis of lymphedema, supported by appropriate medical
  documentation.
* Prescription for Compression Garments: A prescription from a qualified healthcare provider, such
  as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or clinical nurse specialist. This
  prescription must be for compression garments or bandaging supplies specifically intended to treat
  lymphedema symptoms.
* Medicare Part B Enrollment: The individual must be enrolled in Medicare Part B, which covers
  durable medical equipment (DME) and related supplies.

# The Process
* **Schedule an appointment** with your healthcare provider to discuss your need for compression
  therapy

  * How often they should be replaced
* **Call  Lymphrx.com** - a Medicare-approved supplier — to review your order

* **Receive your compression garments** and begin experiencing the benefits!

## The Recovery Journey
* 0-4 WEEKS POST-OP
  
  ### STEP 1
  
  Designed with adjustable closures and straps, our Step 1 compression garments provide support,
  comfort, and ease of use immediately following surgery.
  
  Studies show medical-grade compression may help **reduce swelling** and bruising, **protect the
  surgical site**, and improve tautness and **smoothness of the skin**.
  
  SHOP STEP 1 GARMENTS
* 4-12 WEEKS POST-OP
  
  ### STEP 2
  
  Once swelling reduces, patients will likely need a smaller size in their post-surgical garment.
  Our Step 2 products are designed with outward facing seams and no closures for comfortable wear
  under clothes.
  
  Medical-grade compression may continue to help **reduce swelling** and **improve comfort**.
  
  SHOP STEP 2 GARMENTS
* POST-RECOVERY
  
  ### STEP 3
  
  Made with Marena's proprietary TriFlex™ fabric technology, our Step 3 garments ensure maximum
  stretch and comfort for continued support after recovery.
  
  Studies show that targeted compression may help **reduce muscle soreness**, **counteract muscle
  fatigue**, and **prevent muscle cramps**.

# The Medical Suppliers with the Most Personalized Service in Maine

## Reach out today to see if we supply the products you need

# Provide an Exceptional Patient Experience

## We are here to help.

Personalized medical care makes a huge difference in a patient's health and recovery. MedCOR
Professionals is a medical supplies store with friendly and knowledgeable specialists to help you
get just what you need. We work directly with product vendors to provide high quality medical
supplies & [home medical supplies][42] to our clients.

##### Get The Support You Need﻿

###### We supply post operative bras for breast surgery recovery

[A doctor showing a tablet to a smiling patient in a medical office.]

### Our family caring for yours﻿

MedCOR Professionals is dedicated to providing personalized and compassionate service. At our
medical supply store, you'll work with professionals who can handle:


* **Filing Medicare and insurance claims**

After you see a medical professional about your ailment, we can help you find the right supplies for
your recovery. We can even help file insurance claims.
* **Contacting vendors, billing, tracking and returns**

If you need something specific for your home care or medical clinic, we'll reach out to our
[vendors][43] to find the products you need. We offer a generous return policy on most items to
ensure you are completely satisfied with your products.
* **Scheduling routine product delivery for your clinic**

Keep your clinic stocked with scheduled product delivery. We have the newest technologies at
competitive prices, so you'll always get the proper supplies and [equipment][44] for your facility.



[Contact us][45] in Scarborough, Maine to order medical supplies for your practice or clinic. Or
visit us today to pick up personalized home care equipment.

### Trusted UK Specialist in Post Surgical Bras & Compression Garments

At The Fitting Service, we specialise in expert fittings for post surgery bras and compression
garments designed to support your recovery with confidence. Whether you're preparing for breast
surgery, liposuction, a tummy tuck or mastectomy,

We stock trusted medical-grade brands including MACOM®, LIPOELASTIC®, Amoena and more.

Visit us in our Maidstone showroom or book a fitting at our London Cavendish Square office. Prefer
to stay at home? We also offer virtual consultations to ensure you find the right post op bra or
compression garment with personalised, discreet advice.

With click & collect, fast UK shipping, and carefully selected recovery products, we're here to
support you every step of the way.

### Trusted UK Specialist in Post Surgical Bras & Compression Garments

At The Fitting Service, we specialise in expert fittings for post surgery bras and compression
garments designed to support your recovery with confidence. Whether you're preparing for breast
surgery, liposuction, a tummy tuck or mastectomy,

We stock trusted medical-grade brands including MACOM®, LIPOELASTIC®, Amoena and more.

Visit us in our Maidstone showroom or book a fitting at our London Cavendish Square office. Prefer
to stay at home? We also offer virtual consultations to ensure you find the right post op bra or
compression garment with personalised, discreet advice.

With click & collect, fast UK shipping, and carefully selected recovery products, we're here to
support you every step of the way.

## Whatever your procedure,

Every patient's journey is different. We specialise in fitting the right garment for your specific
surgery and your body.

breast procedures, with brands chosen specifically for post-surgical healing.

Tummy tuck, liposuction, arm lift, thigh lift and flank procedures. Medical-grade compression

Specialist breast forms, post-mastectomy bras and breast prosthetics fitted with care, sensitivity

[More about private label with tytex][122]

## 

## Distribute our established brands

For distributors and commercial partners, Tytex branded products offer a fast and reliable path to
market.



Built on decades of medical textile expertise and manufactured within our integrated European value
chain, our products combine regulatory confidence, clinical performance, and user comfort helping
you grow with solutions healthcare professionals trust and patients prefer to wear.



With products across eight therapy areas already developed, regulatory-ready, and supported by a
comprehensive marketing toolbox, Tytex enables you to launch faster, reduce complexity, and build a
stronger healthcare portfolio with confidence.









[more about brand distribution with tytex][123]

## WHY TYTEX?

### The European contract manufacturing partner in medical garments & textiles you can rely on



In regulated healthcare markets, reliability matters just as much as innovation.



Tytex combines decades of medical textile expertise with modern European manufacturing and deep
regulatory knowledge. We enable our partners to reduce complexity, accelerate development, and
deliver products users genuinely value. And we have done this more for than 5 decades.



What makes Tytex different is not only our ability to manufacture at scale. It is our understanding
of how medical garments and textiles need to perform in real clinical use: Comfort, fit, durability,
compliance, and patient acceptance.



#### Why partners choose Tytex
* Specialized exclusively in medical textiles 
* European production with full traceability 
* Strong regulatory and quality expertise 
* Proven ability to scale 
* Products designed for real-world healthcare use

At Allwecare, we want to represent special, unique products with extra value to help improve the
lives of people in the Dutch market and to provide them better quality of life. The goal for us with
our products is to keep people self-supporting as long as possible.



That's why we partner with Tytex and why Tytex is a close partner to us: Tytex supply exactly the
special, unique and high-quality branded products, we require. The main reason for our co-operation
with Tytex is quality - quality - quality. It's the best quality we can get in the Dutch market.
Also, Tytex is a stable company and the delivery, service and support is very good.

**Ton Mulder** - Marketing Director & Partner, Allwecare

## contract manufacturing

Develop your own healthcare products with an experienced European partner

We work with healthcare companies, OEMs, and brands to develop and manufacture medical textile
products from idea to finished solution.

Our integrated setup combines product development, regulatory expertise, and scalable European
manufacturing giving you one experienced partner throughout the entire process.


* End-to-end development and manufacturing 
* Regulatory and documentation support 
* Scalable European production 
* Long-term partnership approach 

[More about PL with Tytex][138]

## Compliance built into every step 

Healthcare companies choose Tytex because quality and regulatory compliance are integrated into
everything we do - from sourcing and development to manufacturing and documentation.



Our quality systems are designed to reduce risk, simplify approvals, and support long-term market
success for our partners.



### Our quality foundation
* MDR and global regulatory support
* ISO-certified quality management
* Full documentation and traceability
* Approved and audited suppliers
* Consistent, high-volume production quality

[More about Compliance with Tytex][139]

We value our partnership with Tytex very much. Our collaboration is built on honesty and mutual
ambitions to make sure our end users get access to premium products. We sell a selection of the
Carefix post-op bras and we’re extremely happy with the quality – as is our customers.

# United Medical

Delivering high-quality medical supplies since 1995.

As a family-owned business, United Medical specializes in equipment and supplies for managing
Lymphedema, other various venous diseases, and burn wounds. We collaborate closely with patients and
healthcare providers to deliver optimal equipment, garments, and supplies for effective condition
management and improved quality of life. We partner with therapists, wound care clinics, and other
medical professionals to ensure holistic patient care.

### **We don’t need to twist your arm to see
### how our holistic approach to health & body
### can help you get back to your active lifestyle. **

Providing Osteopathy and Exercise Rehabilitation for all ages, our treatment approach is tailored to
your needs and combines injury diagnosis, prevention strategies, treatment and exercise
rehabilitation to help you manage your injuries. 

We consider your symptoms and diagnose your injuries by looking at the body as a whole and treat the
cause of your pain. We understand that all elements need to work in cohesion for an optimal level of
function and mobility.

Using a range of gentle treatment techniques, such as massage, trigger point therapy and
manipulation, we can assist you with a wide variety of musculoskeletal complaints such as, neck and
back pain, headaches and migraines, sporting injuries, reoccurring injuries, jaw pain, shoulder
pain, sciatica, scoliosis, arthritic pain and tendonitis.

At Victoria Sports and Rehabilitation Clinic, we treat people of all ages across their lifespan for
a variety of musculoskeletal complaints, this includes treatment [during and post pregnancy.][60]

Our clinic is in [Mount Eliza][61]. Appointments can be made [online][62] or you can call Mt Eliza –

### **We don’t need to twist your arm to see
### how our holistic approach to health & body
### can help you get back to your active lifestyle. **

Providing Osteopathy and Exercise Rehabilitation for all ages, our treatment approach is tailored to
your needs and combines injury diagnosis, prevention strategies, treatment and exercise
rehabilitation to help you manage your injuries. 

We consider your symptoms and diagnose your injuries by looking at the body as a whole and treat the
cause of your pain. We understand that all elements need to work in cohesion for an optimal level of
function and mobility.

Using a range of gentle treatment techniques, such as massage, trigger point therapy and
manipulation, we can assist you with a wide variety of musculoskeletal complaints such as, neck and
back pain, headaches and migraines, sporting injuries, reoccurring injuries, jaw pain, shoulder
pain, sciatica, scoliosis, arthritic pain and tendonitis.

At Victoria Sports and Rehabilitation Clinic, we treat people of all ages across their lifespan for
a variety of musculoskeletal complaints, this includes treatment [during and post pregnancy.][60]

Our clinic is in [Mount Eliza][61]. Appointments can be made [online][62] or you can call Mt Eliza –

## Are you looking for compression garments in London? Welcome to Yoga® Model.

We are the sole distributor of the Yoga® range of compression garments in London, UK.

Compression garments are essential in the rehabilitation process of many surgical procedures.

Our company has years of expertise in the manufacture of these garments, which ensures optimal
post-operation recovery.

Yoga® medical approved compression garments are used worldwide by men and women to assist in the
healing process post-op and other medical-related situations such as pregnancy and postpartum.

Our compression garments in London are ideal for weight loss programmes and efforts. They are great
for slimming down and reducing measures and also for your overall wellbeing.

The shapewear range will help you look your best and feel good with its specially crafted garments,
made with only the best and most advanced smart fabrics, suitable for all skin types.

Compression garments are essential in the rehabilitation process of many surgical procedures.

Our company has years of expertise in the manufacture of these garments, which ensures optimal
post-operation recovery.

Yoga® medical approved compression garments are used worldwide by men and women to assist in the
healing process post-op and other medical-related situations such as pregnancy and postpartum.

Our compression garments in London are ideal for weight loss programmes and efforts. They are great
for slimming down and reducing measures and also for your overall wellbeing.

The shapewear range will help you look your best and feel good with its specially crafted garments,
made with only the best and most advanced smart fabrics, suitable for all skin types.

Yoga® works in partnership with some of the most recognisable names in plastic surgery and fitness
